The start and end of the day go well when everyone knows the rhythm. Here is how drop-off and hometime run at The City School, and who may collect your child. The rhythm of the day AM Morning drop-off Bring your child to the gate in the morning and a member of staff walks them in. Your class teacher confirms the exact times for your child's year group. PM Hometime At the end of the day, children are collected from the gate at hometime. Times differ by year group, so your class teacher confirms exact times with you. When times change On the last day of a term, hometime is earlier, and your campus confirms the times with you. Any other change is shared by your campus and posted as a banner on this site. She is the person to ask about books, borrowing and what your child might read next. The school office will pass a message on. ELC runs the bus with Blue Jade, our transport partner. There are no fixed routes: the service is built around the families using it, and we recommend it for families living within about five kilometres of campus. Here is how it works day to day, and who to call when it does not. Getting a place BUS Bus places are arranged when you join Signing up for the bus is part of the admissions process, not something you book here. There is no booking or payment on the portal, and there is no plan to move it here without telling you first. Already with us and want to add the bus Contact the school office and they will put you in touch with the person who looks after transport, who will then work through it with you directly.
